concept: EC2 cost optimization: Trusted Advisor + Compute Optimizer (right-sizing)
tests: Which services give automated recommendations on idle resources and EC2 right-sizing (choose two).
expected: AWS Trusted Advisor — flags idle/low-utilization resources; AWS Compute Optimizer — right-sizing recommendations based on utilization metrics. Triggers: "idle resources", "right-sizing", "underutilized instances", "recommendations".
why_not: Inspector — security vulnerabilities; AWS Config — configuration compliance; neither gives cost recommendations.
